quarterly_data.quarter: GE Vernova press release: Blue Energy, GE Vernova Hitachi Sign Agreement to Launch (08-12-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Blue Energy and GE Vernova Hitachi Nuclear Energy (GVH) signed an agreement launching the next phase (engineering design, licensing, safety analysis) of a 2.5 GW gas-plus-nuclear plant in Victoria, Texas that will deploy GE Vernova 7HA.02 gas turbines and GVH BWRX-300 SMRs, subject to a final investment decision in 2027. Blue Energy will initially power a nearby data center with approximately 1 gigawatt from two GE Vernova gas turbines in 2030, then add another 1.5 gigawatts from up to five BWRX-300 SMRs beginning in 2032.
quarterly_data.figure: 2.5 GW plant; two gas turbines, approximately 1 gigawatt in 2030; up to five SMRs, 1.5 gigawatts from 2032; FID in 2027
